name: context-kernel
description: Memory for coding agents that you keep up to date just by talking. It remembers what you tell it, notices when you change your mind, and warns the agent when an earlier recommendation relied on something that changed. Stored locally in SQLite; needs jev, from jevmate. After each turn a line above the prompt says what was saved, with undo.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which memory to use: work, personal, a client. Each scope is kept separate and has its own rules for what gets saved.

db.title: Database
db.description: Where the memory lives. Leave it empty to use ~/.context-kernel/memory.sqlite, which the terminal install and Codex share.

strategy.title: Selection
strategy.description: jev: jev scores each stored fact against every prompt (needs jevmate). rules: keyword matching only. Without jev nothing new gets saved from the conversation.

jev_command.title: jev executable
jev_command.description: Full path to jev. Leave it empty to look in ~/.local/bin/jev, then the jevmate plugin, then PATH. Whether jev runs locally on Ollama or on the hosted service is jev's own setting; /context-kernel:setup changes it.

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: on: after each turn, a line above the prompt says what memory saved, held for review or didn't save, with undo. off: no line (the terminal still shows the hook's message).
